public_rationale: The ordinary reading is supported. Government testing of the October 2024 frontier-model generation found that simple attacks defeated intended safeguards. Technical research explains why extensive testing cannot establish broad guarantees and describes unresolved problems in stronger assurance methods. Restricted formal guarantees already existed, so this finding should not be presented as proof that every kind of AI guarantee was absent or that safe AI is impossible.
limitations: Support concerns the state of broad behavioral assurance, not every narrowly specified AI system.
The direct evaluation covers one frontier-model generation.
Very far is qualitative; the evidence establishes substantial limitations rather than a measured distance to a solution.
